items.html: And the matter is this: ZA, which is the male of the great supernal tree, from there came the Neshama of the first man, and it is called Neshama, because ZA was above, in the place of Bina. And the Ruach of man is from the Nukva of ZA, the small tree, the female, and it is called Ruach, because then his Nukva was in the place of her husband, ZA, as is explained there, in its place, in the Saba de-Mishpatim.
